# Topological_Emergence

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-19

## Definition
The emergence of global computational behavior from the connectivity and local state transitions of a topological network. It is central to TCC because topology is treated as the primary computational resource for emergent system behavior.
